Name: Kana's Barn
Author: sexynes
Description:
This is a buildable barn that can house up to four animals. Very useful if you play with small farms, perhaps to use together with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28915]Shane's Coop[/url] mod, but also on normal farms, you have four more places to put your barn animals and it takes up very little space!
It has several upgrades, all available for purchase in Robin's shop. The exterior will change with the seasons and It has two recolors in addition to the vanilla one, configurable via GMCM.

Enjoy!

This mod was created by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/85287593]sexynes[/url] who did all the coding and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/181358142]7Kana[/url] who recolored the interior, designed the fountain, made the map, drawn seasonal buildings and edited the mod page. lol
